description:
AgentForge: No-Code AI Agent Launchpad for Automated DeFi Yield Optimization
Project Overview
AgentForge is a revolutionary platform that enables users to create and deploy AI-powered DeFi agents without coding knowledge. The platform specializes in cross-chain yield optimization, allowing users to either create their own yield-generating vaults or invest in existing ones.
Core Features
1. Vault Creation System

Users can create customized yield-generating vaults without coding
Set specific parameters for asset allocation and risk management
Define investment strategies through a user-friendly interface
Implement custom policies and constraints for the AI agent
Configure fee structures for vault administration

2. AI Agent Management

AI agents monitor market conditions across multiple chains
Automated yield optimization based on user-defined strategies
Real-time strategy execution within defined parameters
Smart rebalancing across different protocols and chains
Risk management and policy enforcement

3. Vault Explorer

Browse existing vaults and their performance metrics
View historical yields and risk metrics
Transparent fee structures and admin information
Easy deposit and withdrawal interface
Real-time portfolio tracking

how_its_made:
AgentForge is built as a multi-layered DeFi platform that combines AI-driven automation with secure cross-chain operations. At its core, it uses Lit Protocol's Agent Wallet system to create secure, programmable wallets that execute AI-optimized strategies while adhering to user-defined policies and constraints.
The platform's smart contracts are based on the ERC4626 vault standard and integrate with AAVE for lending operations, while using Chainlink CCIP for cross-chain communication. The AI agent system continuously monitors market conditions and executes yield optimization strategies through registered tools that are bound by predefined policies.
Users interact with the platform through a React/Next.js frontend that provides intuitive interfaces for vault creation and management. Behind the scenes, a Node.js backend coordinates the AI agents and manages market data analysis, while smart contracts handle the secure movement and management of funds across different chains.
The vault creation process is simplified through a no-code interface where users can define their strategies, which are then translated into executable policies and tools for the AI agent. All transactions and strategy executions are secured through Lit Protocol's MPC-based key management system.
For cross-chain operations, the platform leverages HyperHarvest contracts that utilize Chainlink CCIP to securely bridge assets and execute strategies across different networks while maintaining optimal gas efficiency.
The system implements a comprehensive security architecture that includes multi-layered policy enforcement, secure key management, and automated risk controls to protect user funds while maximizing yield opportunities.
Each vault operates as an autonomous entity, with its AI agent working within the defined parameters to optimize yields while automatically distributing profits between users and vault creators according to predetermined fee structures.
